newsitem.title: UK: Pharmacia says Q1 sales, earnings lower.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia says Q1 sales, earnings lower.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc. on Wednesday said sales dropped six percent in the first quarter and earnings per share before non-recurring charges were expected to drop by around 16 percent.

"We are pleased with the continued performance of new product launches but we are certainly disappointed by our overall results," Jan Ekberg, president and chief executive officer said in a statement released in London.
Pharmacia attributed the first-quarter sales shortfall to adverse exchange rate movements and customer inventory adjustments after a strong final quarter in 1996.
Weak demand in Europe, particularly Germany and Sweden and generic competition in the U.S. also ate into sales.
Ekberg said the company would announce plans to improve its performance when its quarterly results are released on April 29.
